question: 订单总数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order

question: 总销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order

question: 7月销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-07-01' AND create_time < '2026-08-01'

question: 8月销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND create_time < '2026-09-01'

question: 9月销售额
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-09-01' AND create_time < '2026-10-01'

question: 7月订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-07-01' AND create_time < '2026-08-01'

question: 8月订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND create_time < '2026-09-01'

question: 9月订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-09-01' AND create_time < '2026-10-01'

question: 退款订单总数
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count FROM ecom_order

question: 7月退款数
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-07-01' AND create_time < '2026-08-01'

question: 8月退款数
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND create_time < '2026-09-01'

question: 9月退款数
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-09-01' AND create_time < '2026-10-01'

question: 每月退款率
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) AS month,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric/COUNT(*),3) AS refund_rate FROM ecom_order GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) ORDER BY month

question: SKU 销量排名
sql: SELECT sku,SUM(buy_num) AS units_sold FROM ecom_order GROUP BY sku ORDER BY units_sold DESC,sku

question: SKU 销售额
sql: SELECT sku,SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order GROUP BY sku ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 品类销售额
sql: SELECT g.category,SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_goods g ON g.sku=o.sku GROUP BY g.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 品类退款数
sql: SELECT g.category,SUM(CASE WHEN o.refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunds FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_goods g ON g.sku=o.sku GROUP BY g.category ORDER BY refunds DESC,g.category

question: 商品总数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM ecom_goods

question: 库存总量
sql: SELECT SUM(stock_num) AS stock FROM ecom_goods

question: 库存最低的 SKU
sql: SELECT sku,stock_num FROM ecom_goods ORDER BY stock_num,sku LIMIT 1

question: 平均订单金额
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount),2) AS avg_amount FROM ecom_order

question: 8月退款率
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric/COUNT(*),3) AS refund_rate FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND create_time < '2026-09-01'

question: 7月与8月退款率
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) AS month,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric/COUNT(*),3) AS refund_rate FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',create_time) ORDER BY month

question: 10月订单数
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-10-01'

question: 竞品价最低
sql: SELECT target_sku,compete_price FROM competitor_price ORDER BY compete_price,target_sku LIMIT 1

question: 平均竞品价
sql: SELECT AVG(compete_price) AS avg_price FROM competitor_price

question: 商品与竞品差价
sql: SELECT g.sku,g.price-c.compete_price AS gap FROM ecom_goods g JOIN competitor_price c ON c.target_sku=g.sku ORDER BY g.sku

question: 8月品类销售额
sql: SELECT g.category,SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_goods g ON g.sku=o.sku WHERE o.create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND o.create_time < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY g.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 8月 SKU 退款贡献
sql: SELECT sku,SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunds FROM ecom_order WHERE create_time >= '2026-08-01' AND create_time < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY sku ORDER BY refunds DESC,sku

question: 未退款订单数
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN refund_flag THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS non_refunded FROM ecom_order

question: 最大订单金额
sql: SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount FROM ecom_order

question: 最小订单金额
sql: SELECT MIN(total_amount) AS min_amount FROM ecom_order
